the cart outside the agency's front door

Fresh lemon juice and sugar syrup blitzed with ice into a sharp, very sweet slush, with mint and lemon wheels. Dissolve 150g caster sugar in 150ml hot water and cool. Blend with 150ml lemon juice, 300ml cold water and 4 cups ice until slushy. Pour into 4 glasses, add a lemon wheel and mint sprig and serve with spoons and straws.

steps.text: Put a 25cm cast-iron pan in the oven and heat to 210C.
Mix the dry ingredients, then stir in the buttermilk, eggs and melted butter.
Pour the batter into the hot greased pan and bake until golden.
Beat the softened butter with the honey and serve with the cornbread cut in wedges.
Blitz the beans with the garlic, lime juice, cumin and chipotle until smooth.
Spoon into a bowl, top with crumbled feta and coriander and serve with corn chips.
Spread the rye slices with mustard and fill four of them with pastrami and Swiss cheese. Close the sandwiches.
Toast in a pan with the butter over medium heat until the cheese melts, turning once.
Cut on the diagonal and serve with pickles.
Crumble the cake and mix with the icing until it holds together.
Roll into balls, push in the sticks and chill.
Leave to chill so the balls firm up.
Melt the white chocolate, dip each ball and stand upright to set.
Brush with silver lustre dust once set.
Dissolve the sugar in the hot water and cool.
Blend the syrup with the lemon juice, cold water and ice until slushy.
Pour into glasses, add a lemon wheel and mint sprig, and serve with spoons and straws.

s.note: Skillet cornbread straight from the farmhouse oven with honey butter.
s.how: Heat a 25cm cast-iron pan in the oven at 210C. Mix 200g cornmeal, 125g flour, 2 tsp baking powder, 1 tsp salt and 2 tbsp sugar, then 350ml buttermilk, 2 eggs and 80g melted butter. Pour into the hot greased pan and bake 20 minutes. Cut in wedges with 50g butter beaten with 2 tbsp honey.

s.note: Smoky black bean dip with feta, coriander and corn chips
s.how: Blitz 2 drained tins black beans with 2 garlic cloves, juice of 2 limes, 1 tsp cumin and 1 chipotle in adobo until smooth. Spoon into a bowl and top with 80g crumbled feta and coriander. Serve with corn chips.

m.note: Toasted pastrami and Swiss on rye with mustard and pickles.
m.how: Spread 8 slices rye with deli mustard. Fill 4 with 500g sliced pastrami and 8 slices Swiss cheese, close and toast in a pan with 20g butter over medium heat, 3 minutes a side, until the cheese melts. Cut on the diagonal and serve with pickles.

w.note: Cake pops dipped in white chocolate and brushed silver
w.how: Crumble a 500g butter cake and mix with 100g cream cheese icing until it holds together. Roll into 16 balls, push in sticks and chill an hour. Dip in 300g melted white chocolate, set, then brush with silver lustre dust.
